criteria.text: Identifies the threatened $2,750,000 claim by Kingsmere Engineering Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Calculates the long-stop date as 28 May 2026 (90 days after signing on 27 February 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 12 July 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies the conflict between the 20-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 20-day period or aligns the documents.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 4 October 2027 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 4 April 2029 (36 months after Closing).
Flags that the board minutes and the disclosure letter are inconsistent about litigation.
Gives the long-stop period as 90 days and as the date 28 May 2026, with days remaining from 9 March 2026 (80 days).
Identifies required third-party, board or regulatory consents/approvals and whether each has been obtained.
